turns.speaker: Senate Sergeant-at-Arms
turns.text: All persons are commanded to keep silent under pain of penalty while the Impeachment Court is in session for the trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: The Impeachment Trial of Vice President Sara Zimmerman Duterte is hereby called to order. We shall be led in prayer by Senator Judge Mark Villar.

turns.speaker: Sen. Mark A. Villar
turns.text: Let us put ourselves in the presence of God. Almighty Father, we humbly stand before you today as we resume trial in this impeachment court. We beseech you to bless and inspire us so that all we think, say, and do aligns with your will. In times of adversity, we ask that you renew our spirit, keep our focus steady, and grant us the physical, emotional, and spiritual strength required for the magnitude of our responsibilities. We lean fully upon your grace to sustain us. Fill our hearts with wisdom, discernment, and integrity. Lighten our minds with clarity to carefully weigh the evidence before us, stripping away all confusions. We may examine every testimony and record the objective fairness, distinguishing truth from speculation. Shield us from the traps of personal bias, political variance, or divisiveness that could cloud our judgment, and grant us the grace to put the justice

turns.speaker: Sen. Mark A. Villar
turns.text: before gain, the plight of the Filipinos before our own, and truth above all.

turns.speaker: Sen. Mark A. Villar
turns.text: Fill our hearts with wisdom and understanding in all our judgments that we may be effective channels of truth and justice. Grant us the grace of true independence, giving us courage to stand firm in what is right against political pressures and outside influences, remaining faithful to our solemn oath to the Constitution and the people we serve. Give us humility to seek your will, the truth that may be fully revealed under your light as we take our final steps. Continue to guide us so that peace and accountability may prevail. May our concluding judgment be rooted entirely in fairness, integrity, and righteousness for the fulfillment of your greater glory. In Jesus' name we pray. Amen.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian
turns.text: Trial suspended.

turns.speaker: Sen. Sherwin T. Gatchalian

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: suma total ay magiging Reasonable or expected. Hindi nakakagulat. Wala pong discrepancy na

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: nalabas. Okay

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: po. Sa inyo pong professional opinion pa rin, Atty. Cabrera, bakit po importante na isama sa analysis ng kasong ito yung pera, investments, properties, business interests ng asawa ni VP Duterte?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Well, dahil po yung unang-una po yung requirement po sa SALN ay dapat pong i-file kasama po yung properties po, business interest po ng mag-asawa.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Well, because of absolute community of property, kung ano po yung kitain po ng asawa po ay kita rin po nung may bahay. In this case po, si... BP Sara. So hanggat wala pong prenuptial agreement at kung absolute community po yun, mabubuwag lang po yun ang judicial decree of separation or if not, separation of properties. Pero kung may ganun po, wala rin pong naisubmit sa amin. Kaya po talaga pong magkasama po yung ginawa po namin.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: So dahil sa batas at dahil sa presumption nyo sa property regime na namamagitan sa kanilang dalawa, Ganito po niyo, Quinenta, na isinama po yung kay Atty. Carpio din.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: At

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: sa batas din po, ano po yung rason kung bakit nga isinasama yung asawa sa SALN declarations at sa pagdetermina ng unexplained wealth?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Accountability po, siguro. Yun po yung mahalaga doon. Kasi kung may absolute community of property kayo, kasama po sa accountability na i-declare niyo yung property po ng asawa. Kasi po, ilipat niyo lang po doon, ligtas na po kayo. I-push niyo lang sa kanya. O wala akong property ha, property mo yan lahat. E di ligtas na. So para po magkaroon po ng accountability, pinapakupko po ng batas na i-declare po sa iisang SALN.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: And actually pag tinitingnan po natin yung definition ng mga salita, accountability ibig sabihin talagang pwedeng ikwenta. So na-account po yung ganitong mga assets sa mga SALN. And then paulit-ulit din po binabanggit sa buong trial halos na may separate personality ang korporasyon sa may-ari nito. So, bakit po dito sa computation ninyo, isinama nyo yung assets ng mga kumpanya sa yaman ng isang VP Duterte?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Opo, yung simple ko pong paliwanag nung una pong araw is kung hindi nyo po pinasok sa loob ng korporasyon, ang ibig sabihin ay paghahati-hatihan nyo yun. Pero sinundan po nga ni Honorable Shell ng May legal basis ba yun? Yung legal basis nga po na sinabi ko is piercing the veil of corporate fiction. Alam niyo po sa forensic review, marami pong panginabang ang piercing the veil of corporate fiction. Ginagamit po yan pag nagli-liquidate po ang kumpanya. Pwede bang habulin yung mga may-ari ng kampanyang yun in a liquidation case? Pagka hinahabol po ng manggagawa yung pong kumpanya, Pwede bang i-pierce yung bail para makakolekta sila ng salary kung agency sila halimbawa at hindi sila makakolekta dito sa pinagtatrabaho nila kasi nasa agency sila, pinipierce po yung bail na isa kayo, ganyan. So dito naman po sa atin yung pong substantial under declaration po ang dahilan po ng pag-pierce ng bail. Ito pong pag-pierce ng bail ay Isinasa isang tabi po ang korporasyon pag ginagamit po ang korporasyon sa pang-aabuso. Kasi po yung korporasyon po napakaganda po ng ano eh. Napakaganda po ng nagagawa niyan para sa negosyo. Ang isang tao na may konting kapital ay pwede po magtayo ng maliit na restaurant. Pwede po siya magtayo ng maliit na restaurant. At halimbawa lang po, ang kanya pong investment po doon ay 100,000. Halimbawa lang po. Pagka meron pong nasira ang tiyan at nalason po sa kanyang restaurant, at ang sabi, ang laki ng medical bill ko, ang bill ko umabot ng 5 million. Pagka po sino niya po yung restaurant, hanggang 100,000 lang po yung makukuha niya.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Generally, kasi po may corporation, the corporation is only liable to the extent of its assets. Pero pag napatunayan po na ito pong may-ari po ng restaurant, eh sobra pong pabaya.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Manok na luma, hinahalo. At mga isda na luma, hinahalo. So, sobra pong pabaya po. Tapos sabi niya, hindi ka na makakulekta sa akin eh. 100,000 lang makakulekta mo

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: sa akin kahit na nalason kita. Lasunin man kita, wala kang magagawa. Yung po yung ano, yung po yung inaabuso mo yung korporasyon para maprotectan yung sarili mo. Doon po yung mga pagkakataon na pinipierce po yung veil of corporate fiction po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: So ito pong pagpierce ng veil of corporate fiction, in a way, paraan din para panatilihin yung orihinal, tamang at... Magandang layunin ng pagkakaroon ng mga korporasyon sa negosyo

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: at pinipigilan

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: yung pang-aabuso nito.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: So yung pagpinilis po yung bail, para pong walang korporasyon. Tapos yung mga stockholders po doon, para lang po silang group of persons working together. So hindi po papayagan na... Pero depende po sa inyo, honorable judges, kaya tulad nga po na-point out po ng defense na hindi naman conclusive yung aking report ng piercing of the veil. Nasa inyo po yun kung sa tingin niyo po tama po na i-pierce ang veil.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Nabanggit po earlier yung tax code po, 30%. E ito po, e ano eh. We're talking of 87% under declaration.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: for GenCorp 69, for Metro City Chow, more than 50% for Cale88. So much more po than the threshold.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Nagdodoble o nagtitriple sa threshold ng 30%. And yung pang-aabusong pinipigilan ay alang-alang sa mag-asawa na may absolute community of property. Alang-alang din pala sa mga manggagawa sa usapin ng... Katarungan panlipunan, maaring alang-alang sa kalusugan ng isang customer na food poisoning. Sa inyong mga halimbawa. Salamat po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Kailan po pwedeng sabihin na may unexplained wealth ang isang opisyal? Basta po bang may hindi dineklara sa SALN ay unexplained wealth na po yun?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Meron pong marami pong Supreme Court decisions po dyan na binasa ko rin po bago po gawin yung

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: trabaho pong ito.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Ang nakikita ko po, hindi po yung fact that it was not declared, not that mere fact per se,

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: but

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: the deliberate concealment of the property. Pero po yung pag sinabi pong deliberate concealment o sinadya po talaga na itago yung property,

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: para pong

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Akala niyo po mahirap because it goes into the state of mind. Di po ba na deliberate ba o hindi.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Pero

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: ang sagot po dyan mismo ng batas is it manifestly disproportionate. Kasi pag manifestly disproportionate po, wala na pong usapan sa intent. Halata na po eh. Halatang halata na po eh. Sorry, hindi ko sinasadya. Halata na po. Tapos taon-taon po. Kaya po naging ganyan po yung report po namin.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: So mayroong parang may finding na sadya ito, naitago. Tapos, sobrang halatang anlaki kumpara sa kita and then paulit-ulit over time.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: O,

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: speaking of concealment, sa inyong assessment pa rin, may mga senyales ba na sadyang itinago itong 817 million pesos plus mula sa batas at mula sa mata ng publiko?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Yung senyales po, nandoon naman po. Gagamitin ko na lang po yung percentage po ng under-declaration or under-reporting kasi nga po yung sinasabi ko na that makes it manifest. That makes it manifestly disproportionate. Tapos po yung mga kumpanya po na hindi po ka panipaniwala yung mga financial statements. Ang lalaki po ng kita, ang liliit po ng capital. Ang lalaki po ng kita, lugi po ang bottom line. Ito po yung mga tell-tale signs na meron pong fraudulent reporting po na nangyayari.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Alright,

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: salamat po. Ah, pwede nyo rin po bang ipaliwanag yung naririnig natin na modus na either, modus sa manager's check, I mean, either check kiting, tinikling, or yung binanggit nyo kanina lang na revolving door. So, paano po ba yan nangyayari or paano ginagawa?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Hindi po yung naobserbahan ko lang po dito. Actually, first time ko po nakakita nung ganun po yung manager's check po na labas-pasok po. Pero totoo na po yung sinabi ng defense. Wala po doong pirma si BP Sara doon sa manager's check. Pero yung time deposit po na yung nakapangalan po sa kanya pero wala po siyang pirma.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Nawala po yung interest doon eh.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: O

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: kahit sabihin po natin hindi nakapangalan kay VP Sara, medyo may accountability naman po siya sa bank account because end or po yun. Nawala po yung interest doon sa time deposit at dahil ginawa pong manager's check. So to give up Interest on a large amount like that doesn't really make any business sense. Dahil malaking

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: interest

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: din, dahil malaking principal. Kaya di na po kayong magpahinga ng konti ng mga ilang araw dun po sa interest na yun. So yung manager's check po na patawid-tawid, maaari pong hindi natin talaga alam kung ano yung intention nun. Di po ba? Pero the fact po na paulit-ulit po, nagtitinikling po siya sa… Dulo po ng taon. Yun po yung point po namin na it is a concealment method. Pero again, tama naman po yung defense that this is prior to 2022 and yun nga po wala pong perma doon si BP Sara pero that is the behavior of that account.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: At

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: kaya revolving door naman yung isang image nyo ay dahil parang sa building na labas-masok sa

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: lobby at sa sidewalk.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Oo po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Yun naman pong yun eh. Simptomas po yun ng money laundering. Again, wala po ito sa report ko at hindi ko po sinasabing may money laundering pong nangyayari dito. Sinasabi ko lang po ay simptomas. Pag ang pera po ay pumasok sa kumpanya, lumabas po the same day o lumabas po the following day. Ang ibig sabihin po nun, it didn't add any value to the company. Parang kontrapelo sa

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: logic ng pagnenegosyo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Opo, parang ginagamit kang pass-through. Parang may mapagpasukan lang na parang kunwari ginagamit sa negosyo kasi pinasok po dun sa kumpanya. Kaya po yung tawag po dun yung revolving door. Pagpasok po, ikot labas. Ganon po yung... ng nangyayari po sa typical money laundering transactions po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: And

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: speaking of transactions within one day, meron po kayong nabanggit sa Isang specific date dito sa table 24 sa page 18 na August 6, 2024. Kung kailan nagkaroon ng total cash withdrawals na 41 million pesos in a matter of 1 hour 13 minutes. Unusual po ba ang ganitong klaseng mga transaction?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Sa ordinaryong tao po, unusual po. 41 million in cash. Kailangan niyo po siyempre ng bag po doon.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Parang may hinahabol po eh kasi lahat po ginawa within the hour po. Pwede rin pong i-check yun eh sabi ko nga po. Ba't hindi nilang may managers check at i-deposit sa bank account na iba. Pero pagka po kasi cash, ibig sabihin ayaw po ng trail.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: So kung wala pong trail, ito po sa amin yung ano eh, mga telltale signs din po sa forensic investigation eh. Pagka po yung mga transactions po kulang sa trail, kulang po sa record, wala pong document evidencing it pero nangyari po yung transaction, yung pong walang document nangyari yung transaction, evidence din po yun eh. Bakit, ba't wala yung document? Bakit wala yung governance? Bakit wala yung mga required corporate and regulatory documents na makakapagsabi kung ano talaga yung mga details ng transaction na yun?

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: So bakit

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: walang governance as evidenced by the document trail? May binanggitin po kayong

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Nagmumukhang may hinahabol. Ano yung bakang hinahabol sa ganung klaseng mga transaksyon na ang suma total ay malaking halaga tapos maaaring gawin sa loob lamang ng kulang pa sa dalawang oras?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Tinignan po kasi namin po din yung mga timestamp. Tapos inaanalyze po namin yung mga timestamp malapit po sa bawat isa.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Except

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: po yung timestamp po nung huling withdrawal na 12.37 or so. Tapos yung katuloy niya po ay mga alauna 12.23pm tapos 1.17pm. Nag-lunch po muna.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Nag

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: -lunch muna tapos kinuha po yung... So yun po kaya sa amin parang may kinahabol kasi right after lunch tuloy yung transaction. Matagal din po kasi magbilang ng 41 million.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: I guess po. So iniimagine niyo rin pala po kung paano talaga nag-unfold yung events na yun po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Ganyan po talaga ang forensic investigation po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Yes sir. Huling tanong na lang po. So yung Cale88 ay nakatanggap ng 319 million pesos mula sa China na finlag ng AMLC.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Lumalabas po ba yan sa audited financial statements?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Ang audited financial statements po kasi ng Cale88, everything po is in pesos.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: So hindi po namin malaman kung yung dollar po na kinonvert sa Peso. Pero tulad nga po nung nasabi ko po sa inyo kanina, magkaiba po yung bank accounts na peso at yung dollars po. At hindi po namin nakita kung paano po yun na na-convert po. Pero pag in-add nyo naman po yung peso equivalent po nung dollar remittances tsaka po itong local, yun naman po yung ginamit namin to compare po what was declared.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: So kahit hindi nga po natignan yung dollar transactions, may teorya po ba na pwedeng i-base sa forensic report kung saan naman pumunta yung perang yan, yung 319 million pesos na yan mula sa China?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Pasensya na po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: It's okay po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Ma'am, wala po kaming teorya po doon eh. Although... Sa peso account po, meron po mga konting credit memo na yun po, possibly po sigurong galing sa foreign account pero wala rin po kaming katibayan doon. So wala po kong theory po doon, wala po kong pagbabasihan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Risa Hontiveros
turns.text: Marami salamat po, Attorney Cabrera. Salamat po, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Thank you. Senator Judge Pangilinan is recognized. You may proceed, sir, when you're ready.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Presiding

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Officer. Magandang hapon po sa inyo, Atty. Cabrera.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Magandang hapon din po sa inyo, Honorable Judge.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Ay, idadagdag ko lang doon sa unang mga, yung mga tanong ni Sen. Tiveros. Yung August 6, 2024, sabi ninyo, 41 million ang winitdraw sa isang araw at parang may hinahabol. So, ako rin naging curious dito, kaya... Inisip ko ano ba nangyari nung August 6 o kaya thereabouts. Just to place on record, si Vice President Sara Duterte resigned as DepEd Chairperson July 19, 2024 and then on July 30, it's in the news and we can google it because that's what we did, drug charges were filed against attorney Manse Scarpio. Doon sa yung tawag dito. Magnetic lifter. So July 30 yun. So that was the filing was July 30 and then six days later nangyari ito. Kaninong account pala itong 6 August 2021?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Pareho po kay Atty. Man Scarpio po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Both kay Atty. Mans Carpio. Just for the record. Doon naman sa report po ninyo, nabanggit nyo yung safety deposit box or vault? Do you remember that?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Opo,

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: wala rin naman pong kahinatnan. Hindi ko po alam kung anong laman doon po. Yes, yes. So, nirecord lang po namin doon na klinose na po yun.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Yes, pero that was safety deposit box 27, 28, 29, and 30. Open on October 11. but all boxes were closed on January 7, 2025. Sa araw.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Hypothetically, and based on your professional experience, anong nilalagay sa safety deposit box?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Mahalagang bagay po. Valuable things po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Tulad ng?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Hindi dito sa kasong to, no? Because you wouldn't know. Pero based

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: on your...

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Jewelry po. Mga mahalagang jewelry po ng family. Mahalagang dokumento po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Mga dokumento?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Apo. Paminsan-minsan po. Even very sentimental things po. Nandun po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Pera, nilalagay din sa safety.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Of course po. Opo. Pero may banko naman po. Ba't kailangan pa ng safety deposit box? Meron naman pong mga... Malaman po yun na valuable properties, not money. Kung ako po yung tatanungin.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Pero pwedeng pera.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Pwede rin po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Pwedeng cash.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Theoretically po, pwede po. Opo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So yun lang, no? Kasi nabanggit nyo, no? Lahat sinara sa isang araw. That just gives us pause to think, no? Manager's checks ba nilalagay din sa... Doon naman sa manager's checks, nabanggit na naman kanina, no? Usual ba yun na you issue the manager's check to yourself and then you do it 12 times in a period of... Three years? I mean, again, have you encountered that practice?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Well, honestly po, first time ko pong nakita po yun.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Kasi yun, hindi ba usually pag manager's check, babayaran mo yung binili mo lupa, so yung pinagbilihan mo, yung seller, sa kanya naka-issue yung manager's check.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Alam niyo po itong manager's check po na lumalabas po at the end of the year. para po hindi po mahuli yung cash at hindi magkaroon ng discrepancy sa SALN. Hindi po siya effective eh.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Kasi

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: po pagka nilabas niyo yung manager's check, ang ibig sabihin po nun, yung bangko ay may utang sa inyo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: So

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: kung may utang sa inyo yung bangko, meron kang receivable.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Ibig sabihin,

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: dapat naka-declare po yung receivables sa SALN. So kung hindi po cash ang naka-declare doon, dapat po i-receivable. Kaya hindi po effective eh yung paglabas-pasok po na yun.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: In other words,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: kasama pa rin sa declaration ng iyong net worth, yung receivables.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Dapat po. Receivable niyo po yun eh. May pruweba po noon dahil nakapangalan po sa inyo yun eh.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So naka-declare ba yung receivables doon sa SALN sa pag-aaral ninyo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: May mga nadaanan po. Siyempre wala po. Yun nga po yung point nung paglabas. Kaya wala pong receivable po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Kasi

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: 96 million.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: 41 tsaka 55 po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: So

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: you're saying dapat yung 96 million na yun na managers check, dapat nakareflect sa SALN ng receivables na 96 million.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Tama po. Kasi po yung SALN po as at. So yung as at po certain date, wala po yung cash.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan
turns.text: Pero

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera

turns.text: Mr. presiding officer, did Atty. Cabrera beat the record of Executive Director Benaventura?

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Tinanong ko kayo kanina, Tito Sen, kung mahirap yung tanong sa sagot niyo. Buti na lang tinanong ko a few minutes ago.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: I

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: will respond.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Depsek, Deputy Clerk of Court, Mavic just gave it to me. Labindalawang oras po umupo dyan si Atty. Ronel, si Atty. Cabrera, kumatapos tayo ng alasais, samput kalahating oras pa lang. So silver medalist lang ito kung saka

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: -saka.

turns.speaker: Sen. Vicente C. Sotto III
turns.text: Okay, so you do not get my felicitations, but you receive my gratitude. Thank you very much for staying there, the witness. And that's all. Thank you, kind sir.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Senator Judge Lacson is recognized.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo “Ping” M. Lacson
turns.text: Two very quick points, Mr. President Officer, just so we can rectify and spread it to the records, about the SALN. With all due respect to the Presiding Officer, tama po si Artur Di Cabrera na pag-real estate, acquisition, pati improvements kasama. So, para lang maliwanag yung, this is a spare Section 8A of RA 6713.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo “Ping” M. Lacson
turns.text: Pagka po personal properties, hindi kasama improvement. Alimbawa yung sports car ni Sen. Lapid, nilagyan ng mag-wheel. Hindi na po kailangan i-declare. So yun lang po. Pangalawa po, hindi ko alam kung fact-check ang tawag dito kasi chat GP ito yung aking reference.

turns.speaker: Sen. Panfilo “Ping” M. Lacson
turns.text: Yung isang franchise, isang store ng Jollibee, in 2022, 35 to 55. Tama po yun. Pero 2025, 40 million to 70, 45 million to 70 million. So tama po kayo. Very conservative yung inyong ginamit ng mga figures. Thank you, Mr. Presiding Officer.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: And

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: to continue with the SALN, while some forms include fair market value of the real property, it is not part of the computation of the net worth. Only acquisition cost is factored in with respect to computing the net worth as per civil service regulations. Just brief interjections from this representation before we call it a day.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Honorable Diokno, just to put everything in perspective, given that Atty. Cabrera is your last witness. Your Article 2 allegation in the complaint is Respondent VP Sarah Duterte committed culpable violation of the Constitution and betrayed public trust when she, quote, amassed unexplained wealth manifestly disproportionate to her lawful income and earnings during her incumbency as a public official. I presume this is for the period 2022 to 2025, correct?

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: And that is why you presented bank officials, insurance officials, and the AMLC, I guess.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: B. Failed to fully and truthfully disclose all her and her spouse's assets, liabilities, net worth in her statement of assets and liabilities and net worth, including her SALN for 2022, 23, and 24. That is why, again, those witnesses were presented, including now, Attorney Cabrera.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: failed to divest and instead willfully continued all her business interests during her tenure as VP for the years 22 to 2025. That's why the SEC was presented, I guess.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: As well as the SALNs, if your honor, please.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: As well as the SALNs with the Office of the Ombudsman, yes, correct. Thank you, Honorable Diokno. No, still on you.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So, you alleged unexplained wealth, correct?

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Which is different from ill-gotten wealth.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Ika nga sa Tagalog, unexplained wealth, hindi may paliwanag na yaman, ill-gotten wealth, nakaw na yaman.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Hidden wealth also you did not allege. Sa Tagalog, tagong yaman.

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Now, what Atty. Cabrera, Atty. Alex stated is unexplained wealth, which is not exactly defined by law.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Or are you aware of any law that defines unexplained wealth?

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: I believe it appears in Section 8 of Republic Act 1319. In

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: connection with the declaration that you have to make?

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Yes,

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: in connection with Republic Act 1379, Section 2, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Again, in relation to the declarations you have to make?

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Yes.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Correct?

turns.speaker: Rep. Jose Manuel “Chel” I. Diokno
turns.text: Yes, Your Honor.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So, thank you very much, Honorable Diokno.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Attorney Alex,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You know the definition of unexplained wealth when you used it in your tables?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Apo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Unexplained wealth po is the property, the value of the property acquired which is manifestly disproportionate po to the income. Yun po yung ginamit ko po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Now, you pierced the corporate veil. Para sa simpleng salita, isinangtabi nyo yung pagkakaroon ng hiwalay na personalidad ng isang korporasyon sangayon sa batas at tinignan nyo. Yung aktual na mga may-ari sa likod ng korporasyon na iyon, yung mga stockholders mismo, tama po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Under existing law, as a lawyer too and as an accountant, you can only do that for three reasons. Number one, kapag ka ginamit po yung korporasyon para makaiwas sa mga bayarin o mga kontraktual na obligasyon, ito po ba yun o

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: hindi?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Hindi po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Kasama kung yung kontraktual po, hindi po namin alam kung sino po yung pinagkakaupang.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Hindi nga po yun yung base yan. So hindi po. Ang pangalawa, fraud, illegality or perpetration of a wrong. The corporation is used to justify a wrong, protect fraud, commit or conceal a crime, circumvent a statute or work injustice against another.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Pwede na po magamit po yung pangalawa pong yan dahil po sa tax fraud po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Pangatlo, alter ego or instrumentality. The corporation is a mere farce, business conduit, adjunct or instrumentality. with no genuinely separate mind, will, or existence in the transactions involved.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Yan po, possibility po yung pangatlo pero yung pangalawa po yung ginamit po namin.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Pero ang nasa ilalim po nung pangalawa ay fraud.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Fraud po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So ang rason nyo kung bakit nyo isinantabi yung separate corporate personality ay fraud?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Nakita ko po yung ginawa ninyo sa GenCorp, unahin po natin yan. Binanggit na rin ito kanina nila Sen. Pia at Sen. Camille. Kung tama ang sinabi sa valuation base sa open source ni Senator Judge Lacson ng halaga ng Jollibee conservatively at 35 million, nilagay niyo po sa page 10 ang inyong findings. You can check your findings, sir. Yung 35 million.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Nilagay niyo po, kada taon nag-contribute yung shareholder na si VP Sara ng 35 million. Tama po ba? Ay hindi

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Ano

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Yung 35 million po doon, yung po yung... continuously undeclared na attributed capital po namin.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Attributed na capital contribution nino? Ni

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: BP Sara po. Yung 35 po, nauulit lang po yun dahil it continues to be undeclared po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So hindi to, so minsan lang to dahil kung limang Jollibee branches times 5 is 175.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Hindi po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So dahil 20% divided by 5, 35.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So hindi po ito na double booking, binanggit lang na... Kada taon, ito yung halagang hindi na dedeklara.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Pero

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: hindi ito kinarga ng limang beses doon sa 817.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Tama po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Ngayon, pagdating naman po sa Metro Chow, sinabi niyo po, advance from shareholders. Pareho din po ng GenCorp, dahil wala naman pong capital contribution na diretso yung mga shareholders sa authorized capital stock, in-assume po natin, base sa AFS, na nag-advance yung mga shareholders. Tama po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Yung sa AFS po yung may advances lang po is Cale88 po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Ah, Cale88 lang. Eto pong GenCorp, in-assume lang po ninyo ito.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Ay, nasa GIS po yan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yung shares po, hindi yung advances of shareholders.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Ay, wala po kaming advances ng GenCorp.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: There is no record of advances of shareholders for GenCorp. Wala

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: po. GenCorp and Metro City Chow po wala po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Wala po. So Cale lang ang may advances of shareholders.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So pag sinabi mo pong advances ng shareholders, pautang po ito? shareholder sa kumpanya.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Pautang po ng shareholder sa kumpanya po. So,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: binook niyo po ito as asset receivable.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Tama po, receivable.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Pautang eh. Sa kumpanya po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Sa kumpanya? Sige, sila po

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: dapat, sila po dapat yun.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Payable po yan ng kumpanya po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Utang nga po ng kumpanya kay vice president.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Ah, sa... kay Atty. Manz Carpio. Ah,

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: sorry, sorry, kay Atty. Manz, yung Cali. So,

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Utang po ng Cali88 yan kay Atty. Manz.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Hindi pa po nababayaran. So, receivable po siya.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Receivable po siya ni Atty. Manz po. Payable po siya ng company po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Payable ng company, receivable ni Atty. Manz. Matuturin niyo po bang asset yan?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Na

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: kailangan ideklara sa SALN?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Dapat rin po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Bakit po? Hindi pa naman bayad yung utang.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Hindi po. Dapat po siyang i-deklara po sa SALN po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Bakit nga po?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Dahil po receivable po siya.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So lahat ng receivables from the accounting point of view, maski hindi pa aktual na nababayaran, kailangan mo i-deklara bilang parte ng asset mo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kasi baliktad po, kapag nag-advance naman ako sa future dividends, utang ko naman yun. Bale yun eh. Parang bumalay ako sa kumpanya. Bumalay ako sa boss ko. Yun naman po ay utang ng shareholder sa kumpanya. Di

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Apo, advances to employees po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kahit

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: shareholder.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Or stockholders.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: mentioned the amounts of money that came in and out of the corporations.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: And

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: sabi mo, pumasok yan dyan, alang nga namang hindi nila pinaghati yan. Di ba yun po

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: yung sabi niyo?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Pag hindi po pumasok, Pag hindi po pumasok.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Pag hindi na deklara sa kumpanya pero nakita sa bank account na may pumasok na pera, malamang pinaghatihan yan.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Sinisimple ko lang po yung piercing the veil.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Opo, pero...

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Opo yun po.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Tama po kayo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Pinapasimple ko pa nga po lalo. So, nakita nyo sa AMLC, nakita nyo sa bank records, may pumasok na pera, hindi na deklara sa EFS ng korporasyon, sa malamang pinaghatihan nila yan.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Pero dahil walang dineklarang dividend, advance po ito against future dividend.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Maaaring po niyong i-record ng ganun po, pero ang recording po kasi sa accounting, yung reflective po of the transaction.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Opo, pero kung walang dineklarang dividend, e di advance po siya against future dividend.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Hindi

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: po ba?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Mahari pong advance against future dividend? Mahari po yan.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: You've

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: been in the

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: business for several decades, sir, Atty. Alex. I'm sure you know that that is a practice by most of the big corporations. They simply make an advance against future dividends because the tax will only be imposed once the dividend is declared.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Honorable Presiding Officer, kaya po... Kaya po, kung naninimbang sa aking sagot, totoo po na advance against future dividend po, pag nakarecord po sa financial statements at binibigay po sa stockholder po ng on record, ang kakaiba po dito ay hindi po ganun.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Pero dahil nga in-assume ninyo na, di ba, malamang pinaghati-hati yan, ang tamang pag-record nun ay advance on future dividend, kung nirecord

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: nila. Sige po, kung nirecord po nila, opo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: At kung ganun po, ano po yan, utang?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Utang po nila sa kumpanya.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Utang po nila sa kumpanya.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: So dapat po kung mag-a-appear man yun sa SALN, payable

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Nasa liabilities.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Opo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Kung dineklara nila.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Sa kasong ito, hindi rin po

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: dineklara. Hindi po

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: nakadeklara kasi po ginagamit po yung korporasyon para po makapagtago. Kaya po hindi po yung liability sa company. Kasi isusubi na po yun. Yun po yung tingin po doon.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Sa pananaw na po ninyo yun. Wala na po sa dokumento yun.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Yung parting isusubi.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Wala

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: po sa dokumento yun.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Wala po sa dokumento. Subalit po, Honorable Presiding Officer, hindi po nating masabing utang nila sa kumpanya. Pag-pinierce na po yung will, sila na po yung kumpanya eh. Utang nila sa sarili nila.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Opo. Pero hindi rin nga dineklara sa SALN yun.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Tama po. Wala pong declaration ng income, wala pong declaration ng...

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: May natanong po sa inyo kanina to. Ako po ay nag-compute at gumamit ng calculator. Kung duda ako sa GenCorp, ang kabuang GenCorp sa parte ng 817,874,867 ay humigit kumulang 26% o 25.9% o katumbas ng 212,629,718. Kung hindi po ako kumpinsida sa inyo.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Tama

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: po.

turns.text: Kung duda ako dun sa ginawa nyo sa Metro Chau at saka dun sa Cale88, ang kabuhan po noon ay 142,198,690 o 17.3% ng 817 million ninyong kabuhan.

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: So

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: pag tinanggal ko po yung dalawang yun may maiiwang pa rin 56.6% mula sa inyong calculation o yung base sa Sa bank accounts, sa insurance policies, ang may iwan po ay 463,046,459 na unexplained wealth base po sa computation niya. Tama po ba yan?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Kung wala po yung mga corporation po. Kung

turns.text: wala po yung mga corporation?

turns.text: Apo.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
turns.text: Would that be correct?

turns.speaker: Atty. Alexander B. Cabrera
turns.text: Tama po.

turns.speaker: Sen. Francis "Chiz" G. Escudero
